title: Chill Twisted Salt E-Liquid – Raspberry Watermelon 30ml
description:
Description
Sour candied blue raspberries twisted up with juicy watermelon for a blend that will surely twist your tastebuds!
30ml Bottle
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Chill is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
